description: Reconnect the browser if its connection was lost or it is not running yet. If a start command is configured the browser is (re)started.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL the browser should open when it is (re)launched. Substituted into the {url} placeholder of the configured start command. Required when that start command contains a {url} placeholder. Only http and https URLs are accepted.

name: reconnect_browser
